name: @solidjs/signals
reason: The packages of a Solid release move together, and @solidjs/compiler has no 2.0.3, so every Solid package stays on 2.0.2, the newest release all four share.
liftWhen: @solidjs/compiler publishes 2.0.3 or later and it is old enough to install.
